answer: One concrete defense is a stake-bonded identity atlas: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so each fake identity costs real money up front. A single audit thread then traces an agent's actions across epochs like a glacier carving one channel — repeated behavior leaves a slow, visible record that cannot be faked cheaply. An attacker spinning up thousands of Sybils pays the bond thousands of times while the audit thread links their shared patterns, so the cost of the attack grows linearly while the gain stays flat.
